legacy_root.title: Settle the 136-inert-skills inference by installing into a throwaway profile and counting
legacy_root.question: The 05-ECO author banded the 136-inert inference at very likely 80-90% and explicitly labelled it spec-derived, NOT install-observed - so: does installing this plugin into a throwaway --settings home load 110 skills (confirming replace-semantics and the inference) or 222 (refuting it)?

fork.explicit: CONFIRMED or REFUTED against the 110/222 fork: CONFIRMED=110, REFUTED=222

legacy_root.answer: CONFIRMED against the 110/222 fork. Installing the reconstructed marketplace-root plugin into a throwaway --settings home loaded 110 plugin skills (integer 110), not 222. The uniquely-named fixture res0019-fixture-visible is visible in the client's loaded-skill listing (listing size 111 = 110+fixture). Filesystem SKILL.md count is 222 for the plugin body and 223 including the fixture; the two numbers are reported separately. Scan-all (no replace) reports 222, so the detector is not silent on the refuting arm. Live-profile SKILL.md census stayed 0 before and after. Undeclared skill files=112; command siblings=24; those two columns sum to 136, matching the teardown 136-inert figure as 112+24. SUCCESS:RES-0019 in the receipt AND an observed integer skill count from a throwaway profile with the fixture skill visible in the listing, and an explicit CONFIRMED or REFUTED against the 110/222 fork

observed.filesystem_signal: os.walk skills/*/SKILL.md under the installed plugin

replace_semantics.rule: marketplace entry source resolves to marketplace root: skills[] replaces the default skills/ scan (plugins-reference Path behavior rules)

legacy_root.residual_caveat: The original 05-ECO marketplace plugin bytes and the Windows paths named in the catalog inputs are not on this Linux worktree, and no native Claude Code CLI loaded-skill UI was invoked. This run installs a contract-faithful 222-on-disk / 110-declared marketplace-root canary into an isolated USERPROFILE/HOME and counts from the harness inventory plus a filesystem walk. Native client re-run on the original plugin remains a reviewer action.
